title: feat(studio): the object Settings tab speaks business language, keys as small print, developer options last
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9GNMYnbm5cgRkMqUGpXobrR)_
Fixes #36512
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用 Studio 改对象的人,在对象的「设置」页签上会看到:标题改成了业务说法,页面上不再出现 ADR 编号;设置项旁边用灰色小字标出键名,可以选中复制;内部名称、默认谁能访问、额外需要的权限移到页面最下面的「开发者选项」,默认展开。
- 属于「Studio 的保存方式和用词」专题,是其中「设置页说业务话」这一张卡,解决管理员看不懂设置页的问题。
- 改的只是文字和摆放位置,每个设置的含义和保存的内容都没有变;如果有措辞不妥,只影响显示,可以直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

The object Settings tab in Studio is now in two parts, and its wording is written for people who do not know the platform's internals.

- **Business settings first.** Basics (label, plural label, icon and colour, description), who can see which records, how records are shown (record name field, stage field, highlight fields, record page tabs), and features.
- **"Developer options" last.** Expanded, with no switch. It holds the internal name (read-only once the object exists), who can open the object by default (`access.default`) and the extra permissions it requires (`requiredPermissions`). Both parts are the one object inspector, mounted twice through a new optional `split` prop on `MetadataDefaultInspectorProps`. Without `split`, every other host of that inspector draws the whole panel, as before, with no key small print.
- **Keys as small print.** Each setting's title has lost its parenthesised key (`(nameField)`, `(enable.*)`, …). The key it writes is drawn beside the title as small grey monospace text, and one click selects all of it. The key sits outside the control's `label`, so selecting it neither opens a picker nor flips a switch, and each control's accessible name is its title alone. Pickers are now named through `label htmlFor`.
- **No ADR numbers or rule codes.** `ADR-0085`, `ADR-0056/0090`, `ADR-0090 D1`, `security-owd-unset` and `(master-detail)` are gone from the tab's strings, in both `en` and `zh`. The studio namespace ships only those two catalogues (`STUDIO_LANGUAGE_CODES`); every other language falls back to `en`, so there is no other language file to sync.
- Saved content and what each setting means are unchanged. The other tabs (Validations, Hooks, Actions, API) are untouched.

### The three rewrites (card item 4)

| Row | Before (en / zh) | After (en / zh) |
|---|---|---|
| Internal name: title | Name / 名称 | Internal name / 内部名称 |
| Internal name: hint | snake_case unique identifier (cannot change after create) / snake_case 唯一标识符（创建后不可修改） | The name code and the API use: lowercase letters, digits and underscores only. It cannot be changed once the object is created. / 代码和接口里使用的名称,只能用小写字母、数字和下划线;对象建好后不能修改。 |
| Default access: title | Exposure posture / 暴露姿态 | Who can open it by default / 默认谁能访问 |
| Default access: options | Public — covered by wildcard grants (default) · Private — needs an explicit grant / 公开 — 被通配授权覆盖（默认） · 私有 — 需要显式授权 | Standard — anyone with access to all objects (default) · Restricted — only people granted this object by name / 标准 —— 能访问全部对象的人都能访问(默认) · 受限 —— 只有被单独授权访问本对象的人 |
| Default access: hints | Covered by a permission set's "*" wildcard grant — the platform default for business objects. · Not covered by "*" wildcard grants: only an explicit grant on this object (or View/Modify All Records) reaches it. … | Anyone whose permission set grants access to all objects can open this one — the usual choice for business objects. · A permission set that grants all objects does not include this one: only a permission set that names this object (or one that can view or modify all records) reaches it. … |
| Extra permissions: title | Required capabilities / 必需能力 | Extra permissions required / 额外需要的权限 |
| Extra permissions: hint | AND-gate: callers must hold every listed capability IN ADDITION to their CRUD grants. Comma-separated capability names (e.g. manage_platform_settings). A name no permission set grants fails closed at runtime. / AND 门：调用者除 CRUD 授权外，还必须持有列出的每个能力。… | On top of their permission to view, create, edit or delete this object, a user must hold every permission listed here. Enter permission names separated by commas, such as manage_billing. A name no permission set grants turns everyone away. / 除了对象本身的查看、新建、编辑、删除权限,用户还必须具备这里列出的每一项权限才能使用这个对象。填写权限名,多个用逗号分隔,如 manage_billing。没有任何权限集授予的权限名会让所有人都被拒绝。 |
| Access section hint | Exposure posture and capability requirements. Enforced server-side by the security engine. / 暴露姿态与能力要求，由安全引擎在服务端强制。 | Who can open this object by default, and which extra permissions they need. Enforced on the server. / 谁默认能访问这个对象,以及还需要哪些额外权限;由服务端强制执行。 |

### Other section titles and hints

| Before (en / zh) | After (en / zh) |
|---|---|
| Semantic roles — Applied consistently across forms, lists and detail pages (ADR-0085) / 语义角色 — 跨表单 / 列表 / 详情统一生效(ADR-0085) | How records are shown — Forms, lists and record pages all show records this way / 记录的显示方式 — 表单、列表和记录页都按这里的设置显示记录 |
| Who can see which records — Baseline record visibility applied before positions and sharing rules (ADR-0056/0090) | … — The starting point for who sees records; positions and sharing rules can open access further / 记录可见范围的起点;岗位和共享规则在此基础上再放宽 |
| Sharing model (sharingModel) — … / 共享模型(sharingModel)—— … | Sharing — who can see and edit records someone else owns / 共享方式 —— 谁能查看和编辑别人负责的记录 |
| Not set — publishing this object is REFUSED (security-owd-unset). The runtime does fall back to "Only the owner can see" (ADR-0090 D1), … | Not set — publishing this object is refused. Left unset, it behaves as "Only the owner can see", but this has to be a deliberate choice, not a blank. … |
| Record visibility is inherited from the parent (master) record through its master-detail relationship. / …通过主从(master-detail)关系继承自父级(主)记录。 | Who can see a record follows the parent record it belongs to, through its master-detail relationship. / 谁能看到这条记录,跟随它所属的主记录(经主从关系)。 |
| Record name field (nameField), Lifecycle field (stageField), Highlight fields (highlightFields), Record page tabs (relatedLists) | Record name field, Stage field, Highlight fields, Record page tabs (key as small print) |
| Capabilities (enable.*) — Record-page features — every switch here is enforced by the runtime | Features — Turn record-page features on or off for this object; every switch really takes effect / 功能开关 — 为本对象打开或关闭记录页上的功能;每个开关都会真正生效 |
| Field change history (trackHistory), Attachments (files), Comments & feed (feeds), Activity timeline (activities), Global search (searchable), Cloning (clone) | the same without the key; Cloning becomes "Duplicate records" / 复制记录, matching the record page's Duplicate / 复制 action |
| (new) | Developer options / 开发者选项 — The name code and the API use, and who can open this object / 代码和接口使用的内部名称,以及谁能访问这个对象 |

"tenant" in the sharing descriptions now reads "organization" / 组织. "Not declared" now reads "Not set" / 未设置.

### Keys changed (studio namespace, `en.ts` and `zh.ts`)

- `engine.studio.settings.`: `semanticRoles`, `semanticHint`, `nameField`, `stageField`, `highlightFields`, `undeclared`, `relatedLists`, `relatedListsUndeclared`, `sharingHint`, `sharingModel`, `sharingDescUnset`, `sharingDescPrivate`, `sharingDescPublicRead`, `sharingDescPublicReadWrite`, `sharingDescControlledByParent`, `capabilities`, `capabilitiesHint`, `capTrackHistory`, `capFiles`, `capFeeds`, `capActivities`, `capSearchable`, `capSearchableDesc`, `capClone`, `capCloneDesc`; added `developer`, `developerHint`.
- `designer.object.`: `name`, `nameHint`, `section.accessHint`, `posture`, `posture.public`, `posture.private`, `posture.publicHint`, `posture.privateHint`, `reqPerms`, `reqPerms.hint`. The object inspector draws these wherever it is mounted, so the Studio create-object and bundle-item editors read the new wording too.

### Everything the tab draws (card item 5)

- **The tab's own catalogue** (`engine.studio.settings.*`, including HighlightFieldsEditor and RelatedListsEditor: add pickers, unlisted/undeclared notes, the preview, badges and column editor): cleaned as above. The two sub-editors needed no code change. Their only same-class text was `undeclared` and `relatedListsUndeclared` ("Not declared"), now "Not set".
- **The object inspector** (`designer.object.*`): cleaned as above.
- **Runtime-assembled, kept on purpose:** picker options drawn as `Label (field_name)` and related-list add options as `Label (entry)`, and the mono names on highlight and related-list rows. These are field and relationship VALUES that tell same-labelled entries apart, not titles.
- **Runtime-assembled, out of this PR:** the spec's controlled_by_parent refusal (see Acceptance notes).

## Tests

- New pin `ObjectSettingsPanel.businessWording-36512.test.tsx` (14 cases; the real object inspector is registered).
  - The en and zh catalogues carry no ADR number, rule code, "snake_case", "AND-gate", "wildcard" or parenthesised key in the tab's keys (floor: 60 keys).
  - The rendered tab shows no ADR text in en-US or zh-CN.
  - All 19 keys are drawn as select-all mono small print, outside any label.
  - Each picker, switch and the internal-name input is named by its title alone.
  - A click on a key writes nothing.
  - Developer options is the last section, has no disclosure control, and holds the read-only name, posture and required permissions. The business rows are not in it, and each row is drawn once.
  - A posture pick writes the same patch as before.
  - Without `split`, the inspector draws the whole panel and no key small print.
- Updated pins:
  - `ObjectSettingsPanel.test.tsx`: the unset-sharing warning now asserts the rule code is absent; it used to assert it was present.
  - `ObjectDefaultInspector.test.tsx` and `ObjectDefaultInspector.sharedSelect-11865.test.tsx`: the new label and option text. The latter also gained the collection-time CEL imports `check:test-source-alias` asks of an edited pin.
- Ablations, each run once after committing, mutation and restore checked on disk with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (restore: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - Key moved inside the capability title label: 2 of 9 cases red.
  - Developer mount given `part: 'business'`: 5 of 14 cases red.

<details><summary>Readings (head e735eb11, origin/main 316f7571)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over ObjectSettingsPanel*, ObjectPanels*, DataPillar*, StudioDesignSurface*, the metadata-admin inspectors and the i18n studio-namespace suite, then `type-check` of `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`, at add42cde: Test Files 421 passed (421), Tests 4494 passed, 1 skipped; lock VERDICT command-exit 0. Rerun at e735eb11 for the two pins it touched: 2 files, 25 tests passed.
- Clause-② measured on the build declaration closure: `@object-ui/app-shell` `dist/index.d.ts` exports nothing from `default-inspector-registry` (the only mention among entry-exported modules is a doc comment in `preview-registry.d.ts`), so the new `split` prop is not on the published face. The studio catalogues are declared as a string-to-string record in `dist/namespaces/studio/en.d.ts`, so the two added keys move no type.
- eslint on the touched files: 0 errors; 1 warning, which was already on main (`no-explicit-any` in the inspector's spec feature-detect).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The `controlled_by_parent` refusal from the spec still cites `ADR-0055 §1` in this one state: sharing set to "Follows its parent record" on an object with no usable master-detail field. The tab shows the save door's words verbatim, by design (objectui#12326), and the text lives in `packages/spec`. carrier: #36526
- A host that registers its own object default inspector, one that does not read `split`, would have its whole panel drawn on both mounts of this tab. No such registration exists in this repository. The built-in one is the only object inspector here.
- Screenshots: before and after, full page, en and zh, on the showcase `showcase_account` object, which is read-only there as a code-installed package. They are at `/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/36512-shots/` (`36512-settings-{before,after}-{en,zh-CN}.png`). A page-text scan counted 2 "ADR" hits before and 0 after, in both languages.

## Verification

**Read first** (by risk):
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectDefaultInspector.tsx` — the split: `KeyedTextField` and `RowTitle` must draw exactly what they drew before when no key is passed.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx` — the second mount and the `SettingKey` placement outside labels.
3. `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts` — the Chinese wording.

**Two-minute check:** `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectSettingsPanel.businessWording-36512.test.tsx` should report 14 passed. Or open any object's Settings tab in Studio: "Developer options" is the last section, and every title has its key in small grey text beside it.
